methodology.snapshot: immutable tuple-of-tuples; both algorithms query this identical representation
methodology.query_validation: exactly one full RC scan in both methods, including rejected indexed queries
methodology.timing: one warmup, median/min of repeated batch-average ms; default garbage collection
methodology.timing_excludes: oracle BFS, workload generation, trace, charts, file IO
methodology.cumulative_time: one actual preprocessing run plus sum of per-query median estimates; not a continuous workload timing
methodology.unreachable_sampling: controlled within/across components; query mix is a task parameter, not algorithm output
methodology.workload_limit: all-connected map only supports 0% unreachable pairs of passable endpoints
methodology.independent_samples: one generated pair; batches are timing repetitions; maps are deterministic case studies
